fresh_primary_sources.finding: SQLite exposes runtime library version and source-id separately from compile-time headers; these identify the loaded library lineage but do not authorize which build or compile options should be trusted.

Linux documents openat2 resolution restrictions specifically for pathname race and attack resistance, including no-symlink and beneath-root constraints. This supports descriptor-relative trust-path hardening but not artifact authorization by itself.

GNU ld symbol versioning can bind external symbols to version nodes and let the dynamic loader reject missing versions; it does not by itself bind ClayCode semantic variant maps or policy fingerprints.

GitHub maps exit code zero to success and nonzero to failure. Therefore a blocked required measurement that exits zero is orchestration-level false-green evidence even when its artifact text says BLOCKED.

hypotheses.claim: Native ClayCode entry requires both language-level WP04 admission and a callee-checked semantic ABI fingerprint; symbol presence or raw C compilability is insufficient.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: ELF symbol versioning plus the C signature is sufficient and the semantic manifest duplicates the loader.
hypotheses.discriminator: Keep symbol/version constant while permuting sum ordinals, nominal types and effect-policy source; compare raw call, ELF-versioned call and semantic-fingerprint guard before policy interpretation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A stale semantic client is always rejected by ordinary symbol version/signature checks with no false accept across the held-out mutations.

hypotheses.claim: SQLite release admission requires exact loaded-object identity plus a trust decision that the caller/model/Frank cannot select.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Caller-provided manifest, binary hash and runtime/source-id self-consistency are sufficient.
hypotheses.discriminator: Provision an owner-authorized root anchor or independently authenticated binary root, then attack alternate same-source builds, caller-manifest substitution, symlink/rename/inode swap, downgrade, verifier swap and launcher bypass before any WAL open.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any caller-controlled path selects an unapproved runtime while all current guards report admission, or independent authorization cannot be established before SQLite use.

hypotheses.claim: SQLite authorization may safely inherit the already accepted immutable Frank binary identity, avoiding a second local privileged anchor, only if binary verification is established first and independently of SQLite with exact anti-downgrade policy.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The fusion creates circular trust or merely moves a swappable verifier into authority over both binary and storage.
hypotheses.discriminator: Construct and execute the boot dependency DAG; attempt verifier/library swap, signed-old-runtime replay, bypass and restart before canonical WAL open, retaining V5 /etc anchor as control.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any verification path reads mutable SQLite before establishing verifier identity, or a still-signed older runtime passes without an explicit floor.

hypotheses.claim: Needle can split into authority-free deterministic route preview and post-authorization exact binding without creating a crown-transfer gap.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The split is inherently TOCTOU-prone; only post-authority routing is safe.
hypotheses.discriminator: Recompose loop-core and mutate action, target, canonical arguments, adapter version and context between preview and bind under truthful, shuffled, provenance-broken and no-reentry controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any post-preview drift reaches plan creation or adapter invocation, or preview itself mints/reserves authority.
